text:
jules: Dropping a tiny prototype for the first-run surface. Idea: compact checklist pinned to the right + three horizontally scrollable sample projects. Quick asks: is the checklist too attention-stealing? Do samples convey intent? Any copy tweaks?

noah: Love the horizontal carousel on desktop. On mobile might be hard to discover. Can we show two cards stacked instead of a horizontal scroll at <420px?

meenal: Agree on mobile stacking. Also, sample card titles read like internal model names (e.g., "assistant-v2-demo"). Need consumer-facing names + 1-line intent.

jules: Good catch. Examples: "Customer Support Bot" (for ticket triage), "Snippet Generator" (code & docs). Short intent under title.

product-bot: FYI: analytics impression event `onboard.sample_impression` firing on mount. Double-check we only send for visible cards.

oliver: Copy on the checklist header: currently "Setup checklist (optional)" — feels wishy. What about "Get set up: recommended steps"? Shorter: "Recommended setup"?

tabitha-a11y: "Recommended setup" is fine. Accessibility: checklist items need clear focus + role=checkbox with aria-checked. Also keyboard users should be able to toggle each step with spacebar.

noah: UX: collapse state default? My read: hide extra details by default, show top-level step titles. Expand on click, but preserve the checkbox to mark as done even when collapsed.

meenal: Button labels on cards: use verb-first CTAs. Suggestions: "Try sample", "Deploy demo", "Fork to project". Be consistent.

jules: Agree. Also consider microcopy under CTA for long-running actions (e.g., "takes ~2 minutes").

tabitha-a11y: Color contrast: primary CTA on dark sample (#FFFFFF on #0065D4) is ok but ghost CTA on light bg is only 3.2:1. Switch to token `bg-muted-strong` for ghost backgrounds or use outline with solid text. Add visible focus ring token.

oliver: Regarding primary sample recommendation: we could auto-surface a recommended sample based on the team's language preference (detected from repo link during onboarding). But fallback should pick a widely useful sample (Customer Support Bot).

jules: Action items: 1) replace internal model names with consumer-friendly titles + 1-line intent; 2) mobile layout: stack cards at narrow widths; 3) change CTA labels to verb-first and add microcopy for run time when needed; 4) checklist: collapsed-details, top-level visible, checkbox tabbable & space-toggle; 5) fix ghost CTA contrast and add focus ring. I'll update prototype and tag reviewers.

product-bot: Reminder: schedule design review on 2004005700 for final signoff.

noah: Quick nit: make sure we keep CTA padding consistent across states. I spotted 8px vs 12px in the mock.

meenal: I'll author copy variants (3 options) and post them here by EOD.

tabitha-a11y: I'll write a short QA checklist (keyboard nav, contrast, screenreader announce when sample changes) and attach to the PR template.

jules: Thanks all — will loop back with updated frames. :sparkles:
